items.text: It's been just over a week since Hazard Levels launched it's 1.0, we hope you've been enjoying your time at The Fox Hole Arms, looting rifts and rustling up cocktails. The team have been working hard tackling your feedback and bug reports. A big thank you to not only for playing but for also reporting your issues to us so that we could get them fixed as quickly as possible.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45799044/f8c5da6e31c7a9abbee50f6ba7906ced78090603.png"]
NEWLY ADDED & UPDATES
The scanner now shows where an open rift leads ("Rift Dimension"), on the rift and on the radar
Added a "Get unstuck" button to the pause menu during a crawl, which moves you to a safe spot nearby (1 minute cooldown)
Dead players can now ping to show their teammates where their revive head is
Newly unlocked cosmetics are now marked as "New" in the Profile menu
The bus now has a billboard which cycles through 7 in-universe adverts
Added shutters and new enemy animations to the Bestiary
The caged wizard in the Bestiary doesn't like being disturbed any more...
Added a new water tornado effect to the Flying Apex's attack
Objects thrown by the Ghost are now highlighted
Rarer ingredients now turn up more often in crawls
Players now get up faster after being knocked down, and can't be knocked down again while standing up
Players coming through a rift now arrive a few metres away from it, facing the way out, and no longer land on top of each other
Automatic doors now stay open while you carry an item through them
Increased the time before an enemy can be staggered again: BUG & ISSUE FIXES
Fixed revived players sometimes getting stuck on a black screen or being unable to move
Fixed players sometimes being left dead with no way to be revived
Fixed revive heads being left behind after a Mass Revive
Fixed the "Crawl failed" screen not showing after a solo death or a team wipe
Fixed rooms sometimes generating inside each other, which could block a doorway
Fixed random teleports sometimes leaving players trapped between furniture
Fixed gnomed players floating up to the ceiling in zero gravity
Fixed players sometimes ending up outside the map when turning back from gnome or item form
Fixed giant ingredients getting stuck inside broken crates
Fixed the game locking up when pressing Escape while a drink is being brewed
Fixed the rift dimension ambience stopping when moving between dimensions
Fixed enemies not flashing when hit
Fixed the pub's bestiary room not filling up for players who aren't the host
Fixed an outline showing as a flat shape when aiming the gravity gauntlet at some drinks
Fixed the cursor showing in the wrong place at on consoles when using a mouse
Fixed nameplates not reaching the screen edges on 16:10 screens
Fixed graphics settings sometimes not being saved
Fixed several crashes, including when accepting an invite, joining a game in progress and quitting the game
Fixed the Simplified Chinese "Connecting to servers" text
Fixed "Two Birds, One Barrel" not unlocking
Fixed "Ship Sheep" not unlocking, Shelby Sheep can be handed in at the collection point again
Fixed "Sugar, Spice, And Everything Nice" , players who already have them all will unlock it the next time they start the game
"Best in Class" can now be unlocked by players who aren't the host
Optimised performance in the pub and in busy fights, with fewer stutters when shooting, throwing items and going through rifts
Reduced shader stutters the first time effects appear
Reduced memory use of the scanner screens: STEAM DECK
Using the trackpad or gyro no longer switches the button prompts to keyboard and mouse: PlayStation 5
Fixed the host being unable to invite players after the first crawl
This isn't just any content drop, this is a MAJOR content drop.
We've got a brand-new enemy who attacks you with its very name, a cocktail that oozes pure radiation, a range of new cosmetics and a new epic DLC that will leave you aMAZEd.
CHALLENGES ADDED

Challenges are now available in Hazard Levels! The Fox Hole Arms features a brand new room where you can access a range of challenges and their unlockable luxury rewards. We're kicking things off with 25 hidden challenges with many more coming soon. Check out our roadmap to find out when. We've also added 25 Steam Achievements that reflect the Challenges.
NEW ENEMY - WIZARD

Not to be confused with his non-magical cousin, Papa Gnome. Wizard sports red robes and a magical staff that can transform you into...A GNOME. You'll know when he's around as his name GLOWS above him.
NEW COCKTAIL - R.A.D.S
Harnessing rift radiation, R.A.D.S allows the player to exude a toxic aura that inflicts damage on nearby enemies.
NEW BAR SNACK - STEADY ON NUTS
Steady on Nuts will give you an upgradable boost to your Stamina Regen, which are purchasable in The Fox Hole Arms.
NEW MASK AND SUIT - MALLARD & TARTAN

Introducing a new starter mask and suit. Duck fans rejoice, a new Mallard Duck mask is available amongst the starter mask set. Plus, a beautiful red tartan suit for those wanting to showcase some Celtic flare.
NEW JUKEBOX MUSIC
A new piece of music is available in The Fox Hole Arms' jukebox.
NEW DLC - MYTHS AND LEGENDS MINOTAUR
This just might be our favourite DLC yet. You don't need to be a lover of Greek Myth to respect the wealth of style in this special cosmetic pack.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4847360/Hazard_Levels__Myths__Legends_Minotaur_Bundle/?beta=0"]
ADDITIONAL SMALL UPDATES
Increased base player health to 200 up from 150
Lowered the required amount to fulfill the quota per dimension
Scale of the facility should now be smaller in earlier crawls
You can now aim/zoom in the camera at any point instead of only when holding items

Charging a throw now changes the outline color as well: Thank you for checking out the latest major content drop for Hazard Levels! What's your highlight from this update? Let us know in the comments below or join us over in the Discord where you can stay in touch with the devs and community.
